title: Create: Galvanized
description: Improve your Iron & Steel equipment with Zinc!
body:
**Improve your Iron & Steel equipment with Zinc! Galvanization adds much more durability and a bit more enchantability to tools and armor.**

 

## Getting Started

First you'll need to get a Galvanized Upgrade Smithing Template, which can be obtained from mineshafts, village blacksmith or pillager outpost chests. Once you have it, it can easily be duplicated with Zinc Ingots and Tuff.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_74d15d77-bf54-469e-8060-4a19088137a5.png)

It can also be created from scratch using a sequenced assembly recipe.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1541133/description_5775276d-4c8d-4b97-92a7-f08e6bf03d0b.png)

To upgrade your equipment, simply put it in a Smithing Table along with the template and a Zinc Ingot.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_e2c19a50-ddda-46d2-bcee-4229d1ad36eb.png)

Galvanized equipment can also be repaired with Zinc Ingots alongside their default repair material (configurable via tag).

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1541133/description_3fb790e5-3da7-479d-8ec5-948b4a0b2ec6.png)

Galvanization is generally more effective on tools than armor. While galvanized tools have 60% more durability, galvanized armor only has about 33% more, however it does have a slightly higher enchantability bonus.

 

## Requirements:

[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) (required). For galvanized Steel equipment, you will need [Create: Alloyed](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-alloyed) (optional).
